kurzbeschreibung: The bell museum of the historic Grassmayr foundry in Innsbruck blends over 400 years of craftsmanship with a fascinating auditory world of discovery.
beschreibung:
Over 400 Years of Tyrolean Foundry Art

The Glockengießerei Grassmayr in Innsbruck is the oldest family-owned business in Austria, boasting an unbroken lineage dating back to 1599. In the adjoining Glockenmuseum, the ancient craft of bell founding is conveyed in an engaging and accessible way.

Interactive Sound Room and Historic Monuments

Visitors witness step by step how molten bronze transforms into harmonically pure bells that chime in cathedrals across the globe. The sound room invites guests of all ages to explore acoustic vibration phenomena and musical pitch structures with all their senses.
